name: REF2-NeRF
aliases: Reflection and Refraction aware Neural Radiance Field
definition: A NeRF-based modeling method for scenes containing a glass case that models refraction and reflection using elements dependent and independent of the viewer's perspective, estimating surfaces where refraction occurs and separating direct and reflected light components.
summary: REF2-NeRF is a NeRF-based method for transparent scenes that simultaneously estimates refraction surfaces and separates direct and reflected light using two independent MLPs.
